data.name: Coin Collector
data.detailed_description:
This is a third-person platformer game where you can freely control your character to avoid dangers.

As a single-player coin collection game, it features platforming and collectible gameplay. You can play leisurely, with no time limits, using your double-jump ability to collect all the coins and achieve victory. During the game, you must be careful of hazardous environments—scalding lava.

Game Background:

As an outstanding coin collector, you won't give up any coin in this world. Upon learning that the pyramid area contains a large number of coins and mysterious treasures, you hurriedly arrive at its outer region. After investigating, you find that in order to unlock the ultimate treasure, you must traverse the lava area and collect all the coins.

Gameplay:

Use your double-jump ability to avoid and pass through the lava area, collecting all the coins along the way to unlock the final treasure chest.
